scope: Independent research-snapshot QA: all original30 and all363 coverage rows. No rights conclusions broadened. No availability or feasibility impossibility inferred from absent evidence.

rules.market: Current qualifying official AVAILABLE observation with material source-form match; not live stock. Parent owns final RU_AVAILABLE/RU_MASS_MARKET decision.
rules.preparation: Chopped/diced/minced/peeled/shredded/drained/thawed are preparation, not independent purchase forms. Frozen purchase state remains separate.
rules.low_fat: Parent-approved generic low-fat product-family criterion, not a fixed US nutrient fingerprint. Exact1%milk, cheese variety, part-skim and low-moisture remain material.
rules.water: Household recipe WATER excluded from retailer SKU requirement; not inferred bottled water.
rules.rice: All four source PDFs directions/notes checked: long-grain parboiled brown rice specified, no ordinary-rice alternative.
rules.missing: NO_QUALIFYING_FORM_YET and ordinary evidence gaps are research gaps, not NOT_FOUND or product unavailability.
rules.margarine: Original trans-fat-free source trait is retained. Ordinary margarine product alone does not establish that trait; new recipes specifying ordinary margarine are outside this audit.
rules.fresh_lime: Approved market-context preparation collapse: fresh lime is purchased for fresh juice/zest; no bottled-juice evidence, source-authored squeeze step, recipe-quantity conversion, or global-code change is claimed.
